Notable Work

Featured Cases.

Selected matters that reflect a commitment to thorough strategy, meticulous documentation and lasting outcomes.

LAND REVENUE

ROR Mutation Appeal — 10-Year Dispute Resolved

Successfully overturned a long-pending mutation entry before the Revenue Tribunal, restoring rightful ownership for a farming family in Anantapur.

CIVIL LITIGATION

Coparcenary Partition Suit — Multi-Heir Settlement

Coordinated an out-of-court partition for ancestral agricultural land among seven coparceners with full title clarity and registered deeds.

PROPERTY DOCUMENTATION

Title Due Diligence — Pre-Acquisition Audit

Identified concealed litigation across 30 years of records, saving an investor from a ₹2 Cr+ exposure on a contested commercial plot.

COURT REPRESENTATION

Permanent Injunction — Possession Restored

Secured a permanent injunction in District Court within nine months, preventing unlawful dispossession of a senior client's residential property.
